messages:
sara.support: Hey team, NimbleRetail is reporting sustained 500/429 spikes and very high tail latency during their morning ramp on Dedicated. They say requests are queueing for ~20-30s before hitting 429s. Ticket #SR-4872. :frowning_face:
kevin.eng-sre: Ugh, saw that alert earlier. Ops-bot posted a scaling error around 08:03 UTC. Can you paste the customer's model config (min/max replicas + burst)?
maria.eng-runtime: Their dedicated config: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=12, burst=true, probe_rate=10r/s, tenancy=reserved-gpu-a. They hit ~18 r/s avg during ramp, bursts to 30r/s for ~90s.
jules.eng-platform: If probe_rate is 10r/s we should still scale to ~12 unless warm pool is empty. Any warm-pool attach failures in logs?
ops-bot: automated-alert: dedicated-autoscaler: scaleup_attempt failed for customer=nimbleretail tenant=nimble-123 code=AttachThrottle reason=image_pull_backoff
kevin.eng-sre: Paste from node logs: ```
I0324 08:03:11 autoscaler.go:421] scaleup failed: attach queue full, probe throttle=true
E0324 08:03:13 pod_controller.go:98] pod nimble-123-warmpool-attach failed: ErrImagePull: failed to pull image: 403 Forbidden (token rotated)
```
sara.support: 403 on image pull? Customer didn't change anything. Could this be related to our auth rotation job? Customer reported no config changes.
maria.eng-runtime: That 403 matches a short IAM token rotation window we had at 08:02. If attach containers can't pull the warmpool image they stay in Pending and warm pool empties -> autoscaler thinks there's headroom but there isn't.
jules.eng-platform: Confirmed. I can see warm-pool size drop from 6 to 0 between 08:02:30-08:03:10 in metrics. Autoscaler still had desired replicas=8 but attach queue grew.
kevin.eng-sre: So sequence: token rotation -> registry 403 -> warmpool pods Pending -> warm-pool starvation -> attach queue accumulates -> scale attempts hit attach throttle and fail -> requests queue -> 429s.
sara.support: Customer impact: ~2k requests over 3 mins got 429s, they called support and flagged a business impact. They've asked for mitigation steps and a postmortem.
support-lead: Escalating to oncall: @kevin.eng-sre @maria.eng-runtime please coordinate mitigation and propose immediate workarounds for the customer.
maria.eng-runtime: Short-term mitigation: 1) Roll forward a manual token refresh for registry creds for nimble-123 (I can do one-off). 2) Temporarily increase min_replicas to 4 and add a pre-warm step to create local ephemeral cache. 3) Add a fallback policy to bypass attach queue and spawn cold pods for severe queue backlog.
jules.eng-platform: I can push a hotfix to autoscaler to treat AttachThrottle failures as transient and retry faster instead of gating further scale attempts by 30s. Patch will need a quick QA.
kevin.eng-sre: For immediate customer-facing mitigation I've asked infra to rotate registry token for their tenant and manually create 4 warm pods. Sara, can you relay that to NimbleRetail and offer a 2-hour SLA credit while we remediate?
sara.support: On it. I'll tell them we're doing token refresh + manual warm creation, and ask them to verify traffic. Also giving them credit offer.
ops-bot: action: registry-token-rotate started for tenant=nimble-123 by maria.eng-runtime (run id=rt-20260324-08:12)
maria.eng-runtime: Token rotate completed, created 4 warm pods manually. Warm-pool back to 5 by 08:12:50. Monitoring request queue now.
jules.eng-platform: I pushed a small autoscaler tweak to increase retry cadence for AttachThrottle; will monitor Canary for next 30m.
kevin.eng-sre: Collecting repro steps for postmortem: - ramp script used by customer (they gave us traffic replay) - attach logs for 07:55-08:15 - token rotation audit - warmpool metrics - autoscaler events. Sara, please attach the replay and customer's schedule to the ticket.
sara.support: Attached replay and schedule. Customer confirms traffic normal now, no further 429s in last 10m. They want a writeup and root cause within 48h.
support-lead: Good. Next actions: (1) postmortem draft by eng-runtime+eng-platform within 48h, (2) short-term autoscaler hotfix roll to Canary today, (3) backfill warm-pool health checks to detect imagepull 403 and fail fast. Assigning owners: maria (token mitigation + postmortem), jules (autoscaler fix), kevin (SRE blameless summary).
kevin.eng-sre: Also proposing we add a metric: attach_queue_length / warm_pool_capacity ratio and an alert at >0.8. I'll open the alert PR after postmortem. :+1:
sara.support: Noted, I'll follow up with the customer and close the escalation once postmortem is scheduled. Thanks everyone. :pray:
